## Ojaven — Primary Venture

Name: Ojaven
Type: B2B SaaS Platform
Target Market: Modern digital agencies
Core Purpose: Simplifying workflows, client collaboration, and project delivery for digital agencies
Status: In Active Engineering
Planned Launch Date: 10 July 2027
Founder: Ajaypal Singh (sole founder)

### Why Ojaven Exists

Digital agencies juggle fragmented tools for client communication, deliverable tracking, feedback organization, and team bandwidth monitoring. As teams grow, managing the toolchain becomes overhead that competes with creative work. Ojaven brings cohesion to this operational complexity through a streamlined platform built specifically for agency realities.

### Ojaven Architectural Modules

1. Unified Client Portal — Consolidating communication, feedback, and deliverable sign-offs in one clear interface.
2. Operational Core — Cohesive project pipeline tracking commitments, bandwidth, and milestones.
3. Ambient System Automation — Removing administrative overhead through background operational routines.
